mapper.select: SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN FROM APPLICANT_RECORD

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_RECORD_NO = #{applicantRecordNo}

WITH exam_cte ( ex_applicant_id, ex_score ) AS ( SELECT applicant_id, SUM(applicant_score) AS ex_score FROM applicant_answer GROUP BY applicant_id ), interview_cte ( int_applicant_id, int_score ) AS ( SELECT iscore.applicant_id, AVG(iscore.applicant_rating) AS int_score FROM interview_score iscore JOIN interview i ON iscore.interview_no = i.interview_no GROUP BY iscore.applicant_id ) SELECT rp.recruitment_no AS recruitment_no, rp.recruit_process_no AS process_no, rp.recruit_process_step AS step, rp.recruit_process_type AS step_type, rp.recruit_process_final AS final, ar.applicant_id AS applicant_id, ar.applicant_name AS applicant_name, ar.step_application_yn AS attend, ar.step_pass_yn AS pass, ap.user_id AS userid, exam_cte.ex_score AS exam_score, interview_cte.int_score AS interview_score FROM recruit_process rp LEFT JOIN applicant_record ar ON rp.recruit_process_no = ar.recruit_process_no LEFT JOIN applicant ap ON ap.applicant_id = ar.applicant_id LEFT JOIN exam_cte ON ar.applicant_id = exam_cte.ex_applicant_id LEFT JOIN interview_cte ON ar.applicant_id = interview_cte.int_applicant_id WHERE rp.recruitment_no = #{ RECRUITMENTNO } ORDER BY STEP , APPLICANT_ID

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} AND RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = #{recruitProcessNo}

WITH base_user AS ( SELECT #{userId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ), base_applicants AS ( SELECT applicant_id FROM applicant WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM base_user) ), exam_cte AS ( SELECT applicant_id, SUM(applicant_score) AS ex_score FROM applicant_answer WHERE applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM base_applicants) GROUP BY applicant_id ), interview_cte AS ( SELECT iscore.applicant_id, AVG(iscore.applicant_rating) AS int_score FROM interview_score iscore JOIN interview i ON iscore.interview_no = i.interview_no WHERE iscore.applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM base_applicants) GROUP BY iscore.applicant_id ), process_cte AS ( SELECT ar.applicant_id, rp.recruitment_no, MAX(rp.recruit_process_step) AS max_step FROM recruit_process rp JOIN applicant_record ar ON rp.recruit_process_no = ar.recruit_process_no WHERE ar.applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM base_applicants) GROUP BY ar.applicant_id, rp.recruitment_no ), latest_step AS ( SELECT ar.applicant_id, rp.recruitment_no, rp.recruit_process_step AS step, rp.recruit_process_type AS step_type, ar.STEP_PASS_YN AS pass, ar.FAILED_YN AS fail, rp.recruit_process_final AS final FROM recruit_process rp JOIN applicant_record ar ON rp.recruit_process_no = ar.recruit_process_no JOIN process_cte pc ON rp.recruitment_no = pc.recruitment_no AND rp.recruit_process_step = pc.max_step AND ar.applicant_id = pc.applicant_id ) SELECT ls.applicant_id, ls.recruitment_no, ls.step, ls.step_type, ls.pass, ls.final, ls.fail, ec.ex_score, ic.int_score, p.PASS_ALARM_YN, p.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN, p.HIRE_DATE FROM latest_step ls LEFT JOIN exam_cte ec ON ec.applicant_id = ls.applicant_id LEFT JOIN interview_cte ic ON ic.applicant_id = ls.applicant_id LEFT JOIN PASSER p ON p.APPLICANT_ID = ls.applicant_id AND p.RECRUITMENT_NO = ls.recruitment_no ORDER BY ls.recruitment_no
